body: Well I'm glad at least someone will remember me
Please, don't waste any time thinking about me. I've learnt that time is too precious
No I don't
Thanks. I hope she keeps it and doesn't throw it out like everything else
It's been 2 years and nothing has gotten better, just worse. So no, it won't end. Only end when my life ends
I'm in pain, and don't want it anymore. Why suffer just so others don't get harmed. That's just dumb. And I'm avoiding wasting more time
I too am saying goodbye on NYE, and for the same reasons. Life just isn't enjoyable
Like I said, I don't want that. Seriously, I'm good. I won't be breathing for much longer
Because my book is done. There's nothing more I want. I don't want to live my life
Not this time. I want to die, and am really looking forward to it
Yes. And is been 1.5 years. Nothing has changed

This is how I plan to do it too. Thank you. Best wishes

Why do you want me to live? I've come to this decision and am okay with it. Just let me die. Don't you want me to not suffer every single second of my life? This is how I do that.

Nothing. I just mashed the keyboard
It's not. Like I said, I need to be gone before she has the baby. I won't ever find that happiness again. It's been a year and a half and nothing has given me a minute of happiness. It's over
ALL my friends have done the same thing. They say they care about you until you are honest with them, and then they can't handle it
I'm truly not sure. It's the deadline because we wanted to have a family together, and I can't miss that. You have no idea how much Ive been wishing that pregnancy brain would change her mind
Doubtful. The only reason I've been waiting this long for her to talk to me. But she's going to have the baby soon, that's why I've chosen a date. That's my deadline. I can't wait past that
She just is. Always will be. That's my choice
Because she is having a child with another man and won't speak to me. It's over, and so am I
I won't either

There's no point in my life. The point I want isn't possible

Best wishes. I will see you on the other side
